def thanos_sort(arr):
    def is_sorted(subarr):
        return all(subarr[i] <= subarr[i + 1] for i in range(len(subarr) - 1))

    n = len(arr)
    max_length = 0

    for i in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
        left_half = arr[:i]
        right_half = arr[i:]

        if is_sorted(left_half):
            max_length = max(max_length, len(left_half))
        if is_sorted(right_half):
            max_length = max(max_length, len(right_half))

        left_half = arr[:-i]
        right_half = arr[-i:]

        if is_sorted(left_half):
            max_length = max(max_length, len(left_half))
        if is_sorted(right_half):
            max_length = max(max_length, len(right_half))

    return max_length

def max_sorted_subarray_length(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    
    def thanos_sort(start, end):
        if start >= end:
            return 0
        
        mid = (start + end) // 2
        left_sorted = thanos_sort(start, mid)
        right_sorted = thanos_sort(mid + 1, end)
        
        i, j = start, mid + 1
        temp = []
        while i <= mid and j <= end:
            if arr[i] <= arr[j]:
                temp.append(arr[i])
                i += 1
            else:
                temp.append(arr[j])
                j += 1
        
        temp.extend(arr[i:mid+1])
        temp.extend(arr[j:end+1])
        
        arr[start:end+1] = temp
        return max(left_sorted, right_sorted, mid - start + 1)
    
    return thanos_sort(0, n - 1)

import sys

def thanos_sort_length(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    
    def is_sorted(subarr):
        return all(subarr[i] <= subarr[i + 1] for i in range(len(subarr) - 1))
    
    max_length = 0
    
    def helper(start, end):
        nonlocal max_length
        if start >= end:
            return
        mid = (start + end) // 2
        left_half = arr[start:mid]
        right_half = arr[mid:end]
        
        if is_sorted(left_half):
            max_length = max(max_length, mid - start)
        if is_sorted(right_half):
            max_length = max(max_length, end - mid)
        
        helper(start, mid)
        helper(mid, end)
    
    helper(0, n)
    
    return max_length

def thanos_sort_max_length(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    
    def is_sorted(subarr):
        return all(subarr[i] <= subarr[i + 1] for i in range(len(subarr) - 1))
    
    max_length = 0
    
    def dfs(start, end):
        nonlocal max_length
        if start >= end:
            return
        mid = (start + end) // 2
        left_half = arr[start:mid]
        right_half = arr[mid:end]
        
        if is_sorted(left_half):
            max_length = max(max_length, len(left_half))
        if is_sorted(right_half):
            max_length = max(max_length, len(right_half))
        
        dfs(start, mid)
        dfs(mid, end)
    
    dfs(0, n)
    return max_length
